decisions.capability: Resume the same native child and reconcile a local effect after interruption
decisions.evidence_scope: One native inherited-tool child completed cancellation, same-child continuation, abrupt parent-runtime failure, automatic systemd descendant cleanup and same-parent/same-child finalization with an unchanged checkpoint and one local effect.
limitations: One synthetic local task on this WSL host; not general worker reliability or an OS sandbox.
Not host/user-manager crash, independent-host recovery, remote provider cancellation, cessation of billing or distributed exactly-once effects.
Restricted Bash-only role incompatibility and every original failure remain retained; only this inherited role is accepted.
The successful run did not request ls, so the exact rewrite permission diagnosis is deterministic evidence rather than an exercised native approval success.
Native usage views overlap; initial SIGKILL has no terminal record. Complete parent/child/retry usage, billing and savings remain unknown.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the accepted same-host fixture while inputs match; qualify changed application effects or an independent host only when that scope is required.

decisions.capability: Resume one scheduled native workflow after an orderly owned guest reboot
decisions.evidence_scope: A signed disposable Ubuntu guest automatically resumed the same native Dagu run after an orderly kernel reboot, preserved its checkpoint and produced one local effect. A dedicated read-only serial observer and independent journal review confirmed completion before postboot SSH; owned cleanup passed.
limitations: One orderly disposable guest reboot with a synthetic workload; not a physical PC, power loss, production disaster recovery, provider recovery or broker acceptance.
The unchanged official Dagu retry tests are a selected upstream subset. The project planner, its original 12-test oracle and the guest experiment are local synthetic integration coverage.
Source, disk and process continuity cover this owned guest only; no distributed exactly-once or arbitrary external side-effect guarantee.

Public text projections replace owned home prefixes and synthetic UUIDs and normalize CRLF. Original artifact/stream hashes and explicit projection rules are retained; projected bytes are not labelled raw-byte-identical.
The full auth-free guest archive contains three hidden bookkeeping files omitted by loose-file artifact upload. Independent inspection used the intact archive.
Both prior failed attempts remain failures; retrospective successful workload records did not override their missing acceptance evidence.
No model was called and no provider or lifetime token-saving measurement was made.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify the actual deployment and application effects when adopting beyond this orderly synthetic guest boundary.

decisions.capability: Terminate an owned local process tree at its deadline
decisions.evidence_scope: The Linux user manager terminated a TERM-ignoring parent and descendants, retained timeout failure, and accepted a separate fresh run. A separate upstream user-service fixture also contained a TERM-ignoring setsid descendant after MainPID crash. The earlier combined restricted-role trial remains refused; the native-child-interruption-recovery decision separately records the later accepted inherited-role result.
limitations: Local process termination does not prove remote provider cancellation, spending caps or exactly-once effects.
decisions.next_gap: The separate native-child-interruption-recovery decision covers one local cancellation/crash fixture; reconcile external effects before any provider or application relaunch.

decisions.capability: Retry unfinished workflow steps while preserving a checkpoint
decisions.evidence_scope: Native cancellation/retry retained one checkpoint on Mac and WSL; separate SSH-client termination left the same job running to completion. Selected unchanged official Dagu retry tests passed on fresh hosted runners. The additional owned-guest-scheduled-reboot decision qualifies the later orderly reboot without overriding retained failed attempts.
limitations: Controlled transport interruption is not a real network outage or host reboot.
This does not establish remote model cancellation or distributed exactly-once effects.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the separate accepted orderly guest reboot scope; qualify changed deployment boundaries and application effects independently.

existing_overturn_when: Real jobs require host-loss survival, days-long waits or durable cross-host effects, and one challenger passes the declared effect/retry/recovery cases with acceptable operational burden.
limitations: The selected guest reboot is not a physical-PC reboot and does not qualify every schedule or daemon policy.
Local process cancellation does not prove provider billing cessation, external exactly-once effects or durable cross-host orchestration.
requirement: Run selected local workflows with visible history, bounded process trees, cancellation and recoverable effects appropriate to the actual workload.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
